incident: Gate B Batch 1 live run: evidence serialization crash after all requests were sent

failure.stage: runner.execute -> CaseResult.to_dict -> Exchange.to_evidence -> redact.safe_excerpt (after the case loop finished)
failure.exception: TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'
failure.root_cause: websockets exposes a rejected-handshake response body as bytearray; ws.py stored it unchanged; safe_excerpt only decoded `bytes`, so the bytearray reached str-based redaction
failure.reproduced_offline: tests/unit/test_gate_b.py (fake WS server returns a 400 handshake; websockets hands back a bytearray body)
failure.fix: bytes() coercion at the 3 InvalidStatus sites in ws.py; safe_excerpt and Exchange.to_evidence accept any bytes-like body; runner checkpoints each finished case to cases.checkpoint.jsonl and serializes cases independently

lost: All structured per-case results (status codes, request IDs, headers, SSE event counts, SDK item counts, skip-warning counts, timings, real-time event sequences, check outcomes). The per-case console lines were also not captured (the console output was truncated to its last 14 lines, which the traceback filled).

private_artifact.meaning: GB-S1-03 (SDK synthesize_tts, default transport) returned a valid, non-silent 24 kHz WAV

inference_only: Exchange.body is set from a websockets handshake response only on the InvalidStatus path, and the excerpt is taken only for a non-empty textual body, so at least one of GB-RT-01..04 received a non-101 handshake response with a non-empty textual body. Which case, and which status, cannot be recovered. No finding is drawn from this.
not_concluded: No result, pass, fail or finding is claimed for GB-S1-01, GB-S1-02 or GB-RT-01..04.
